products.name: Engine 909
products.description: A drum machine with a step grid and its own knobs for every voice. Drag the pattern into your arrangement as MIDI or audio.

products.name: Synth Thing
products.description: A synth with its own step sequencer. Draw a melody on the grid, drag notes long, or start from a preset that already plays one.

products.name: String Thing
products.description: The same grid, with strings. For pads, stabs and lines that need to hold.

products.name: Bass mit Stimme
products.description: A bass you play from the keyboard, with a voice sample running through it.

products.name: Roar Bass
products.description: A growling bass synth. Two oscillators, FM growl, noise, filter and drive.

products.name: Handy Boy
products.description: A sampler for absolutely everything. Drag in a WAV, AIFF, MP4, MP3, AAC, FLAC or a voice memo and play it from the keyboard.

products.name: Voice Box
products.description: Eight vocal effects in one rack, from autotune to vocoder.

products.name: Ultra Reverse
products.description: Reverse echo: every slice comes back backwards.

products.name: Compressor
products.description: A classic compressor with a duck built in.

products.name: EQ
products.description: Four bands, high-pass and low-pass, curve on screen.

products.name: Quick Delay
products.description: Tempo-synced delay with eight starting points.

products.name: Reverb
products.description: Room, hall, plate and cathedral, one press each.

products.name: Saturation
products.description: Drive, bias and tone, with the curve on screen.

products.name: De-esser
products.description: Tames harsh S sounds in three simple steps.

products.name: Limiter
products.description: Threshold fader, ceiling fader, signal on screen.

products.name: Big Knob
products.description: One knob: low-pass left, high-pass right.

products.name: Pitch Knob
products.description: One big knob that shifts the pitch down or up.
